_schemaNote: TRIAL DATA PACK — NOT a production artefact. Never imported by app code, never written to Supabase/DB, no migration. Lives under tests/fixtures/p2/ only.
changeLog: v1 (P2): initial trial pack — nominal 13 m²/L, PROPOSED_ONLY binding, no DB writes.

v2 (P2.2): coverage range recorded from the OFFICIAL Astral technical sheet for LAKALO SATINÉ (rendement 11–13 m²/L, PER COAT; 13 kept as NOMINAL, not guaranteed); provenance updated; 2 coats recorded as a PRODUCT-LEVEL APPLICATION RECOMMENDATION only (still NO layers=2 anywhere).
_reviewStatusNote: Pack-level gate ONLY. The current schema has NO review_status column on trade_metre_elements, and material_prices.review_status only accepts pending|reviewed|rejected|published — so 'PENDING_REVIEW' is deliberately NOT mappable to any DB write today (that is why the pack is non-publishable).

provenance.origin: Product facts (rendement 11–13 m²/L, per coat) read from the OFFICIAL Astral technical sheet for LAKALO SATINÉ — Astral Tunisia identifies Lakalo as an official product. Element structure still mirrored from the CURRENT CODE (src/data/metreElements.ts registry entry peinture/mur_interieur). Read-only session: 0 INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, 0 migrations, 0 Supabase calls.

productCoverage._note: NOMINAL 13 m²/L = the top of the OFFICIAL Astral 11–13 m²/L range for LAKALO SATINÉ, and it is PER COAT. NOT a guaranteed coverage: real yield varies with support, tool and application, so 13 must be read as 'nominal within 11–13', never as a floor. The binding keeps the NOMINAL value (spec.value = 13) so the P2 formula stays 50 × 1 ÷ 13 = 3.846 L; the min/max are recorded for review only — they are NOT encoded into the binding, and NO waste percentage is added.

applicationRecommendation._note: RECORDED AT PRODUCT LEVEL ONLY (carried from the existing P2 fixture/report context). It is deliberately NOT encoded as layers=2 in the generic peinture/mur_interieur element, NOT in the material binding, and NEVER as a general peinture rule — the generic element keeps layers: null and the Métré quantity is NOT multiplied.

metreElement._note: Byte-identical mirror of the existing registry element (trade=peinture, code=mur_interieur). Legacy shape: NO enriched block, NO layers, NO bindings — see rule 'no layers=2 at this stage'.

_materialCodeNote: 'PROPOSED_ONLY' is a deliberate placeholder required by the MaterialBinding schema shape. It is NOT an official catalogue code, must never be committed to trade_metre_elements.material_bindings, and MUST be replaced by a real, officially created material code (Material Catalog step) before any promotion.

trialExpectation.coverageUsed: NOMINAL 13 m²/L (top of the official 11–13 m²/L Astral range, per coat) — a single-coat yield computation; the 2-coat recommendation does NOT multiply it
